changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS member ( id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
email VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL, password VARCHAR(255), picture VARCHAR(255), role VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
balance INT NOT NULL, last_free_awarded_at DATETIME NOT NULL, last_ad_awarded_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL );
